_readme: Single source for prices, plans, timing, the free sample, add-on, cancellation wording, contact details, the Tally form and payment links. Edit here, then run `python3 site-src/build_site.py`. PENDING_* marks a placeholder still waiting on someone.
currency_note: All prices are per month, plus HST.
currency_footer: All prices in Canadian dollars, plus HST.

rows: TRREB market update, rates news, tip and local post
Monthly recap (1-page PDF and email block)
Your approval before anything is used

items.name: Pro
items._note: Not buyable yet. Shown as 'Coming soon' with no price and a 'Join the waitlist' button. expected_price is kept for later and is not shown on the site.

plans._v6_note: site-v6 shows only plans with availability 'available', as two cards with their 'bullets'. Pro (waitlist) is not shown on the page.

addon.name: Posted for you
addon.description: We schedule your approved posts to your accounts. Nothing posts until you tap approve.

mid_month_note: Signing up mid-month? You get a kit right away, built from the latest TRREB report.

cancellation.faq: Give us 7 days’ notice before your next billing date and you won’t be billed again.

payment_links._note: Live Stripe payment links (CAD, monthly). Plan buttons go to checkout. Empty URL + status not LIVE = plan buttons open the form with that plan picked.

hero.status: v7 DRAFT 2026-11-19 (was: Your market posts, finally on brand.)
hero.headline: Look like the local expert. Skip the content.
hero.lede: Market posts in your brand, with your area’s TRREB numbers, every month.
hero._note: Shown as the H1 and in the page title.

timing._note: Sample turnaround includes Brock's review. Drop to 2 once that review is handed off.

free_sample.summary: One ready-to-post post built to your feed, with this month’s TRREB numbers for your area and a caption to go with it.
free_sample.essentials_line: Essentials adds the whole month: 4 posts built to your feed, covering the TRREB market update, rates news, a tip and a local post.

tally._note: Tally form LD788l. Status LIVE: the page loads Tally's embed and every sample/claim button opens it with hidden fields (choice, path, and vibe/font/palette/preview_name or email when relevant). The form itself must be published in Tally or it will not open for visitors. Newsletter signup is off for the social-only launch (coming-soon line only; no Notify me control). Payment links are LIVE, so Start Essentials and Start Growth open Stripe checkout.
fields: Instagram handle (match my feed) or nothing (starter style)
Link to a few of your own photos (optional)
I have the rights to use the photos I share (checkbox)
tally._v6_note: site-v6.3: newsletter footer is a coming-soon line only (no form). Vibe picks come from a small dialog behind 'I'm starting fresh'; preview_name is sent empty.

welcome._note: After-payment page. Both Stripe Payment Links redirect here (optionally ?plan=essentials|growth&session_id={CHECKOUT_SESSION_ID}). Onboarding form spec: docs/onboarding-tally-v1.md. Set tally_form_id and tally_status LIVE once the form is published; until then the page shows an 'Email us your look' button.

founding.headline: Founding 10: 20% off your first year.
founding.line: Use code FOUNDER at checkout. 20% off your first 12 months, for the first 10 agents.
founding._note: Founding 10 offer (pinned post v2.4). Stripe caps the code at 10 redemptions. Set status to anything but LIVE to hide the band.

newsletter.consent: Email me the monthly GTA market read.
newsletter._note: Do not render an email field, Notify me button, or consent checkbox while status is coming soon. The footer shows the 'line' text only.
